versions.subject: New Rule Linux - Hidden Files and Directories
versions.detection:
commands:
    type: EXECVE
    a0:
        - mkdir
        - touch
        - vim
        - nano
        - vi
arguments:
    - a1|re: '\.(.*)'
    - a2|re: '\.(.*)' #in case there are some other arguments being used in a1
condition: commands and arguments
versions.spl: | rex field=a1 "(?<a1Match>\\.(.*))" | eval a1Condition=if(isnotnull(a1Match), "true", "false") | rex field=a2 "(?<a2Match>\\.(.*))" | eval a2Condition=if(isnotnull(a2Match), "true", "false") | search type="EXECVE" a0 IN ("mkdir", "touch", "vim", "nano", "vi") a1Condition="true" OR a2Condition="true"

versions.subject: Merge PR #5486 from @phantinuss - fix: reduce FP matching with regex pattern
versions.detection:
selection_commands:
    type: 'EXECVE'
    a0:
        - 'mkdir'
        - 'nano'
        - 'touch'
        - 'vi'
        - 'vim'
selection_arguments:
    - a1|re: '(^|\/)\.[^.\/]'
    - a2|re: '(^|\/)\.[^.\/]'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: | rex field=a1 "(?<a1Match>(^|\\/)\\.[^.\\/])" | eval a1Condition=if(isnotnull(a1Match), "true", "false") | rex field=a2 "(?<a2Match>(^|\\/)\\.[^.\\/])" | eval a2Condition=if(isnotnull(a2Match), "true", "false") | search type="EXECVE" a0 IN ("mkdir", "nano", "touch", "vi", "vim") a1Condition="true" OR a2Condition="true"
